Start your Full Stack journey with E&ICT Academy, IIT & 3RI’s advanced certification program! Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri November 4, 2024 4:57 pm Introduction To give professionals and students the most up-to-date knowledge in the area, 3RI Technologies and E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati have partnered to launch an Advanced Certification Program in Full Stack Development . This partnership aims to satisfy the increasing need for full-stack engineers who can easily manage end-to-end development processes and have both front-end and back-end knowledge. The curriculum offers a distinctive blend of theoretical knowledge and practical training, perfect for anybody hoping to succeed in today’s tech-driven employment market, thanks to the combination of E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati’s academic quality, and 3RI Technologies’ vast industry experience. If you’re seeking a transformative full stack developer course in Guwahati, this is your moment. 3RI Technologies, in collaboration with E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati, introduces a prestigious Full Stack Development Certification designed to meet the evolving demands of modern tech industries. The course is perfect for freshers and professionals aiming to become job-ready in both frontend and backend development. What sets it apart? The integration of Cloud Computing, AWS & Azure, offering you an end-to-end full stack and cloud computing mastery. Enroll now to future-proof your skills with top-tier credentials. In addition to thoroughly understanding necessary technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and frameworks like React and Node.js, participants in the Advanced Certification Program in Full Stack Development will also get insightful knowledge about databases, DevOps, and project management. The curriculum is structured to cover every facet of full-stack development, guaranteeing that students gain the ability to work on challenging, real-world projects. By providing this joint program, 3RI Technologies, and E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati is meeting the need for competent, adaptable workers in the tech sector and assisting participants in improving their career chances in the quickly changing digital landscape. Future-Ready Full Stack Certification with IIT Guwahati & 3RI Technologies 3RI Technologies has teamed up with IIT Guwahati’s E&ICT Academy to offer a top-notch certification program that focuses on full-stack development. This partnership blends the academic resources of E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati with 3RI Technologies’ vast IT training experience to produce a strong curriculum that gives learners skills applicable to the workplace. This partnership bridges the gap between theoretical learning and practical application by giving students practical experience with real-world tasks and situations. The program’s main objective is to ensure that learners are not only well-versed in the fundamentals of full-stack development but also adept in advanced technologies that are essential in today’s job market. Participants will acquire front-end and back-end programming skills by working with languages and frameworks, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python, as well as technologies like React and Node.js and database management systems. The course also includes components of agile project management and DevOps to prepare students for the challenges of full-stack employment. In order to meet the growing need for qualified full-stack developers, 3RI Technologies and E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati have created this full-stack development certification program , which equips participants with the thorough knowledge and real-world experience they need to progress in the cutthroat IT industry. Curriculum Breakdown 3RI Technologies and E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati’s Advanced Certification Program in Full Stack Development offers a comprehensive curriculum to develop full-stack development capabilities. Through the following modules, this program seeks to provide learners with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills: 1. Introduction to OOPs Beginning with C++ Beginning with C++, participants learn about Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs), which includes: Functions in C++: Comprehensive knowledge of function construction and default arguments in C++. Objects and Classes Fundamentals: Ideas such as constructors, reference variables, and object-oriented concepts like inheritance and encapsulation. 2. Data Structures and Algorithms This portion of a crucial curriculum covers the fundamental data structures and algorithms needed to create effective applications: Core data structures include arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, and graphs. Algorithmic Concepts: Sorting and searching approaches for improving computational problem-solving abilities. Are you looking after Career Guidance from Experts? Book Now Want Free Career Counseling? Just fill in your details, and one of our expert will call you ! Email Phone Send 3. RDBMS: Basics of SQL This session delves into database management and SQL, teaching fundamental skills in data manipulation: Data and Database Fundamentals introduces data storage, data kinds, and SQL syntax. SQL operations include aggregate functions, sorting, grouping, nested queries, and joins. Advanced SQL manipulations include adding and altering columns, creating tables, and enforcing foreign key constraints. 4. UI Development & React JS With an emphasis on front-end development, this subject gives students the tools to design interactive user interfaces. The fundamentals of HTML and CSS include tables, forms, HTML components, and CSS characteristics like color, positioning, and CSS3 improvements. JavaScript: Data types, events, functions, and conditional expressions. jQuery and Bootstrap: Responsive design techniques. React JS: Addresses event handling, lifecycle methods, component creation, and the React-Redux library for state management. 5. Core Java This lesson improves participants’ knowledge of Java for backend programming by going over the following: Java fundamentals: classes, inheritance, packages, objects, and managing exceptions. Advanced Java features include the Reflection API, Lambda expressions, multithreading, and Java 8. Collections Framework: Methods for handling and modifying intricate data structures. 6. Back End Application Development Students will use REST API development, Spring, Hibernate, and J2EE to create backend apps. Fundamentals of Java EE: Including JSP, Servlets, and JDBC. Spring Framework: Addresses online applications, Spring Boot for quick development, and dependency injection. Hibernate ORM: Hibernate annotations for database interaction, object-relational mapping, and CRUD activities. Developing REST APIs: Putting them into practice and implementing them to create scalable, server-side apps. 7. Deployment of Project on Cloud To prepare projects for production, this topic discusses cloud deployment techniques: GitHub: An introduction to Git and its version control functions. AWS Cloud: Scalable system architecture, application deployment, and core AWS services. Full Stack Project Deployment: Detailed deployment procedures for cloud-based full-stack application hosting. 8. Soft Skills & Aptitude Session This curriculum focuses on personal development and job skills. It includes: Self-Analysis and Goal Setting : Strategies for Personal Development and Goal Achievement. Communication and presentation skills include body language, efficient communication, and email etiquette. Interview preparation includes resume writing, simulated technical and personal interviews, group discussion techniques, and office etiquette. Aptitude training focuses on numeric, logical, and verbal reasoning to enhance problem-solving. To provide students with the technical expertise and soft skills necessary for a prosperous career in full-stack development, 3RI Technologies and E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati’s Advanced Certification Programme in Full Stack Development offers a well-rounded development experience. Email Phone Send Key Features of the Program For ambitious developers and IT professionals, 3RI Technologies’ Advanced Certification Program in Full Stack Development, in partnership with IIT Guwahati’s E&ICT Academy, offers several essential features. This curriculum ensures thorough training in full-stack programming by fusing industrial relevance with academic competence. An organized curriculum that covers fundamental to advanced subjects like object-oriented programming , data structures, algorithms, database management (RDBMS), user interface (UI) development, backend application development, and cloud deployment is advantageous to participants. The curriculum gives students the skills to work on scalable, real-world applications by emphasizing popular frameworks and tools like React JS, Spring Boot, and Hibernate. An essential component of the course is practical projects and assignments that let students apply their knowledge in real-world job situations. Students at IIT Guwahati’s E&ICT Academy receive mentoring from seasoned industry professionals and knowledgeable instructors to grasp challenging concepts properly. The program also incorporates soft skills and aptitude training to prepare students for career progression and interview preparedness. Participants receive a certification upon completion, which enhances their credentials and shows their dedication to professional full-stack development knowledge. Why Choose This Program? Industry-Aligned Curriculum: The program provides a thorough, practical curriculum covering key full-stack technologies to keep students updated with industry demands. Expert Mentorship: To improve their comprehension of complex ideas, participants receive direction from teachers and seasoned experts at IIT Guwahati’s E&ICT Academy. Real-World Projects: Students can apply their expertise to tackle real-world development difficulties through practical assignments and projects. Career-Enhancing Certification: The 3RI Technologies and E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati certification enhances participants’ profiles by demonstrating their proficiency in full-stack development to prospective employers. Career Opportunities Role Description Full Stack Developer Ensures a smooth user experience and functionality by designing and developing both front-end and back-end solutions. Front-End Developer Focuses on developing user interfaces (UI) with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React. Back-End Developer Emphasizes databases, server-side logic, and API connectivity to facilitate front-end functionality. UI/UX Developer Improves interface design and user experience to increase user pleasure and involvement. DevOps Engineer Oversees cloud services, deployment, and development workflows to deliver scalable applications. Software Engineer Works on projects at different phases of development and frequently collaborates with other teams to ensure project success. The Future of Full Stack Development Rising Demand for Versatile Developers: Full-stack developers capable of overseeing both front-end and back-end operations are becoming increasingly in demand as companies look for affordable solutions. Focus on Cloud and DevOps: These competencies are vital for future full-stack positions since cloud integration and DevOps procedures are necessary for scalable apps. Growth of AI and Machine Learning Integration: As apps get more innovative and data-driven, there will be a strong demand for full-stack developers with expertise in AI and ML. Emphasis on User Experience (UX): As competition grows, businesses prioritize UX, which encourages full-stack engineers to improve their user-centered design abilities. The Bottom Line E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati, and 3RI Technologies’ Advanced Certification in Full Stack Programming is a brilliant, job-oriented course that gives students extensive, in-demand full-stack programming abilities. Through a combination of academic underpinnings and practical experience with tools such as React, Spring Boot, and cloud deployment, this program helps participants gain skills that are relevant to the industry. Graduates are well-prepared for various professions in the tech industry thanks to real-world projects, experienced mentoring, and a curriculum that aligns with current tech needs. With this credential, students can boldly pursue fulfilling jobs in full-stack development, one of today’s most sought-after industries.
